proof_rule: Accept mapping only when the compared register's last local definition is normalized_reg = r12 - exact_constant_base, the equality comparison has exact constant delta provenance, and base+delta reconstructs the exact host command.

interpretation_policy: no semantic promotion without exact normalization proof
